:::{#def-training-mse}
#### Training error

The **training error** of a [prediction rule](#def-prediction-rule) $\fitted$
fitted to a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$
is the [mean squared error](estimation.qmd#def-prediction-mse)
of its [fitted values](estimation.qmd#def-fitted-value)
$\fitted_i$, $i \in I$,
as predictions of the training outcomes $y_i$:

$$
\trainerr \eqdef \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i \in I} \sqf{\fitted_i - y_i}.
$$ {#eq-training-mse}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.2], who write the training error as $\overline{\text{err}}$
and define it for any loss.
:::

:::
